parts.title: Part 1 — Introduction and interview
parts.instructions: The examiner will ask you questions about familiar topics. Keep your answers brief and clear.

questions.question: What kind of food do you enjoy eating most?
Do you think environmental problems are serious in your country?
What do you do to protect the environment?
Did you enjoy studying science at school?

parts.title: Part 2 — Individual long turn
parts.instructions: You have one minute to prepare. Then speak for one to two minutes on the topic below.
parts.cue_card_topic: Describe an environmental problem that affects your country.
cue_card_bullets: and explain what can be done to solve it

parts.title: Part 3 — Two-way discussion
parts.instructions: Answer the examiner's follow-up questions in detail.

questions.question: Who do you think should be responsible for protecting the environment — individuals or governments?
What are the main environmental problems facing the world today?
Do you think education can help solve environmental problems?
How might people's attitudes towards the environment change in the next twenty years?
